articles.title: Rochdale Council Seeks Public Input on £20m Spending in Smallbridge, Hurstead and Belfield
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Borough Council and Action Together are inviting residents to share their views on how to allocate £20 million in Smallbridge, Hurstead and Belfield.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Borough Council and Action Together are asking residents how they would spend £20 million in the areas of Smallbridge, Hurstead and Belfield.

The initiative aims to gather community input on potential projects and improvements that could benefit local residents. Residents can participate by scanning a QR code provided in promotional materials.

This engagement effort is part of a broader strategy to ensure that community voices are heard in local decision-making processes.

Residents are encouraged to share their ideas and suggestions to help shape the future of their neighbourhoods.

articles.title: Investigation Launched After Fire at Illegal Waste Site in Rochdale
articles.excerpt: The Environment Agency has confirmed an investigation into a fire at an illegal waste site in Rochdale, which required extensive firefighting efforts.
articles.content_html:
An investigation has been launched following a fire at a waste site in Rochdale. Crews worked throughout the night on July 24 after a fire broke out off Spring Mill Walk, in Smallbridge. Firefighters were called to the scene at 8.15pm and worked until around 1pm the following day.

Thick plumes of smoke were visible for miles around as six fire engines and specialist equipment were deployed to extinguish the fire. The Environment Agency became involved due to the large quantity of waste at the site.

In an update issued on August 1, the Environment Agency confirmed that the fire occurred at an illegal waste site, which is now under investigation. Residents in the surrounding area were advised to keep their windows and doors closed during the incident.

The scale of the operation faced by firefighters was significant, with dramatic images showing the extent of the fire. The investigation will seek to determine the cause and circumstances surrounding the incident.
